units.source_text: 风雨依然不止，雷电亦不停息，一连多日了。

en.t: The wind and rain still did not stop, and the thunder and lightning did not cease either; this went on for many days.

units.source_text: 忧愁之事，不可胜数，源氏公子沉湎于悲惧之中，精神振作不起来了。

en.t: There were countless things to grieve over, and Prince Genji sank into sorrow and fear, unable to rally his spirits.

units.source_text: 倘说为了天变而逃回京都，则我身未蒙赦罪，更将受人耻笑。

en.t: If I flee back to the capital because of these ominous upheavals, when I have not yet been pardoned, people will mock me all the more.

units.source_text: 不如就在此间找个深山，隐遁起来。”

en.t: It would be better to find some deep mountain around here and hide myself away there."

units.source_text: 继而又想：“若然，世人又将谓我被风暴驱入深山，

en.t: Then he thought again, "If I do that, people will say that I was driven by the storm into the deep mountains,

units.source_text: 传之后世，讥我轻率，永作笑柄。”

en.t: and the story will be handed down to later generations, mocking me as rash and making me a lasting laughingstock."
Because of this, he hesitated and could not decide.

units.source_text: 每夜梦中所见，总是那个怪人，缠绕不休。

en.t: Every night in his dreams he saw that same strange figure, haunting him without end.
